rules.requirement: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Your 2 Townsfolk neighbors are poisoned.

assertingTests.name: the No Dashii poisons the nearest Townsfolk even when that seat is dead (SNV-NODASHII-01)
the four Sects & Violets Demons have a step from the second night, choosing one player (SNV-FANGGU-01, SNV-NODASHII-01, SNV-VIGORMORTIS-01, SNV-VORTOX-01)
a Sects & Violets Demon's step changes nothing but the step, and the host's death on its outcome is a Demon death (SNV-FANGGU-01, SNV-NODASHII-01, SNV-VIGORMORTIS-01, SNV-VORTOX-01)
the No Dashii's step resolves to nothing, healthy or impaired: the host marks the death on the outcome (SNV-NODASHII-01)
No Dashii poison is reconciled when the source or a target changes character
a Snake Charmer who chooses the Demon swaps characters and alignments with it and poisons it for good, and the new Demon wakes tonight (SNV-SNAKECHARMER-01)

rules.requirement: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Your 2 Townsfolk neighbors are poisoned.

assertingTests.name: the No Dashii poison ends when the No Dashii dies (SNV-NODASHII-02)
